questions.question: A parent renders <Price amount={12} />. How does Price receive 12?

options.d: As the first array element in state

questions.explanation: JSX attributes become properties on the component's props object.

questions.question: A list may be sorted in either direction. Which key should its row component use?

options.c: A new random string each render

questions.explanation: Stable keys preserve row identity through reorderings.

questions.question: A handler calls setCount(n => n + 1) twice while count is 0. What will the next count be?
questions.explanation: React applies both updater functions in sequence to the pending state.

questions.question: Where should code that saves a form after a user clicks Submit usually run?

options.d: In a render prop that runs every render

questions.explanation: Submitting is a response to a specific event, so the handler owns it.

questions.question: Which operations are safe during render when they only read the current props? Select all that apply.

options.a: Filter an array into a new array

questions.explanation: Local calculations and JSX creation are pure operations during render.

questions.question: What should an onChange handler do for an input controlled by React state?

options.a: Update the state used for the input's value
options.b: Remove the value prop after the first edit
options.d: Read the value and discard it

questions.explanation: The controlled input displays the supplied value, so its state must follow the edit.

questions.question: Two sibling panels must display the same selected row. Where should that shared state normally live?

options.a: In one of the siblings only

questions.explanation: Their common parent can own the selection and pass it to both panels.

questions.question: An Effect subscribes to a chat room and includes roomId in its dependencies. What happens when roomId changes?

options.b: React cleans up the old subscription and runs the new setup
options.c: React ignores the new roomId until reload

questions.explanation: A changed dependency triggers cleanup for the previous setup before the next setup.

questions.question: A component needs to retain a timer handle across renders without triggering a render when it changes. Which Hook fits?

options.b: useMemo with a mutable object dependency

questions.explanation: A ref persists across renders and changing its current property does not request a render.

questions.question: Which places are valid for calling the built-in useState Hook? Select all that apply.

options.b: At the top level of a function component
options.d: At the top level of a custom Hook

questions.explanation: Hooks such as useState must be called in a consistent order from components or custom Hooks.

questions.question: What happens when a component's context provider receives a new context value?

options.a: Readers must call setState manually to see it
options.b: The value becomes a prop of every DOM element
options.c: Consumers that read that context receive the new value
options.d: React converts it into session storage

questions.explanation: Components that read the context subscribe to its value.

questions.question: Which output should a component return when it intentionally renders nothing?

options.b: An empty div with a visible border

questions.explanation: React treats null as empty output.

questions.question: Switching from one customer's editor to another should reset its form state. Which prop can force a different component identity?
questions.explanation: A changed key makes React treat the editor as a different component instance.

questions.question: A list held in state needs one item appended. Which updater returns a new array?
questions.explanation: Spread creates a new array with the added item without changing the previous state.

questions.question: Which values can usually be derived during render from props alone? Select all that apply.

options.a: The current width of an element measured from the DOM
options.b: The price sum of the supplied cart items
options.c: The number of supplied items that match a search prop
options.d: The next value of a persistent timer

questions.explanation: The sum and filtered count are calculations over the current props.

questions.question: What are the two values returned by useReducer?

options.a: A reducer and the initial state
options.b: A ref and a cleanup function
options.d: The current state and a dispatch function

questions.explanation: dispatch sends actions to the reducer, and state reflects the latest result.

questions.question: When passing a handler to a JSX button, which expression waits for a click before calling save?
questions.explanation: Passing the function reference lets React call it when the event occurs.

questions.question: What is the usual role of useMemo?

options.a: Store persistent application data after closing the browser
options.c: Cache a calculation result while its dependencies stay unchanged
options.d: Replace state updates with DOM mutations

questions.explanation: useMemo is a performance tool for reusing a calculation result.

questions.question: Which JSX expression gives a button an accessible visible name of Save?
questions.explanation: Text content supplies the accessible name for an ordinary button.

questions.question: Which changes help an Effect release a subscription when appropriate? Select all that apply.

options.a: Return a cleanup function from setup
options.b: Remove the exact listener that setup added
options.c: Ignore the resource ID in the dependency list

questions.explanation: Cleanup lets React release the listener when the Effect stops using it.
